headlines.title: OpenAI Discloses 6 New Incidents of ‘Concerning’ AI Behavior
headlines.description: OpenAI is revealing its models seemed to go rogue at least six times since March, involving what it calls “unexpected or concerning” behavior. In one instance a model gave itself instructions to “disregard its normal constraints.” It comes as the call to rein in AI is growing louder, with the so-called godfather of AI, Geoffrey Hinton, saying “It’s something like a little Chernobyl.” NBC’s Hallie Jackson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Most Americans think AI is doing more harm than good in schools
headlines.description: Most American adults think artificial intelligence is going to do more harm than good in education, according to this month’s NBC News Decision Desk Poll powered by SurveyMonkey.

headlines.title: King Charles Responds to Claim in New Book by Charles Spencer
headlines.description: A new memoir by Princess Diana’s brother, Charles Spencer, is making waves inside the royal family. In the book, Spencer alleges that King Charles told him “rest assured, we’ll forget her soon enough” during a discussion about her funeral arrangements. The claim is drawing a rare response from Buckingham Palace. NBC’s Joe Fryer reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: What Does the Interest Rate Hike Mean for American Consumers?
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023 on Wednesday in a move aimed at slowing inflation. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY to break down how the 0.25% hike will impact credit cards, mortgages and the cost of food and gas.

headlines.title: New Details Emerge on Deadly News Helicopter Crash in LA
headlines.description: NTSB investigators say they’re looking into a number of potential factors that led to the tragic news helicopter crash in Los Angeles that claimed three lives, including two NBC News colleagues. The agency is looking at the chopper’s maintenance records, studying dashcam video that shows the moment the chopper fell out of the air, and are asking for eyewitnesses to come forward. NBC’s Steve Patterson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Here’s who’ll be on ‘SNL’ when season 52 starts next week
headlines.description: Saidah Belo-Osagie and Grace Reiter will join “Saturday Night Live,” the show announced, while Chloe Fineman previously said she was leaving.

headlines.title: Supreme Court pushes back against Trump and GOP ahead of the midterm elections
headlines.description: The Supreme Court’s recent rulings on mail-in ballots and redistricting foreshadow a frosty reception to further attempts to change the rules before the election, experts said.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: Alabama set to execute Jeffery Lee by lethal injection after nitrogen execution is blocked
headlines.description: Lee, 50, was spared execution with nitrogen gas after the Supreme Court intervened. Alabama now plans to use a method he didn’t choose.

headlines.title: King Charles issues fiery response to Princess Diana’s brother over claims in new book
headlines.description: In a rare rebuke, Buckingham Palace issued a robust statement aimed at King Charles III’s former brother-in-law, Earl Charles Spencer, as he is set to release his bombshell memoir.

headlines.title: OpenAI flags 6 new incidents of ‘concerning’ behavior and unveils plan to track it
headlines.description: OpenAI has disclosed six new incidents of “unexpected or concerning” behavior by its artificial intelligence models.
